notes.title: New 20 Tracks in Major Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Iso Racer Adds 20 New Tracks in Major Update[/b][/p][p]We released a major content update for [i]Iso Racer[/i], adding 20 brand-new tracks to the fast-paced isometric racing game. Available now on Racing Fest 2025, this update significantly expands the game’s track roster and introduces a wide range of environments—from the desert city of Qatar to the tight corners of Mexico![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/86bf4e06405f74a17d65167c11b6ace5e06cb414.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each track offers unique challenges designed to test players’ reflexes and racing strategy. Some emphasize tight corners and drifting, while others focus on acceleration, top speed, or navigating tricky hazards. The update aims to increase variety and replayability, while giving players more reason to compete for leaderboard domination.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/a76e3945b1dd9c8d0e4dfedd3a28ffb717fabb11.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Alongside the new tracks, players can enjoy enhanced visuals, improved handling mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/18545ac6d94b3127ecf4a6c14ead1bacd76276be.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With this update, [i]Iso Racer[/i] continues to build on its momentum as one of the most exciting minimalist racing games on the market.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the track![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5.7.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/840446d88f3f92dc1e76ea835ac5245ec9ef5b3c.png[/img]

[b]In version 0.5.7.1:[/b]

- fixed bugs with vehicle level setting in busted mode

- visual bugs in the garage have been fixed

- drift points work correctly for people joining the lobby

- visual improvement of wheel rotation for those who join the lobby

- visual improvement of tire tracks and smoke for those who join the lobby

- improved performance when drawing new checkpoints in busted mode

- race ending bug fixed

The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes.
